a-missing-fox-talking-to-guildmaster-apa.text: If the player does not meet the quest's requirements:

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Sorry, but you need to be a better hunter before we can help you out.
You need 46 Hunter to access Hunter Guild amenities.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guildmaster-apa.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guildmaster-apa.text: Oh, you're a new face around here, aren't you?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guildmaster-apa.player: I am indeed. Just exploring the savannah.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guildmaster-apa.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guildmaster-apa.text: Well, I'm Apatura. Let me welcome you to our small corner of Varlamore.

steps.player: What do you do here?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: We're mostly here to keep an eye on the local animal populations, and provide animal parts to the city.

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: As for me personally, I'm the current master of this guild.

steps.player: Current master?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: A hunter's work is dangerous. We tend to go through members faster than other guilds. That said, I'm usually too busy with politics and paperwork to go out hunting these days.

steps.player: Could I hunt with the guild?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Absolutely! There's always more work to be done. Head down into the Burrow and talk to the other hunters to get an idea of what we need help with.

options.text: Can I help you with anything?

steps.player: Can I help you with anything?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: I'm not sure if you have the time or the patience, iknami, but a little birdy told me that our esteemed scribe Verity may require some assistance.

steps.player: What sort of assistance?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: If I had to guess, she needs someone to find something for her.

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: She's a wonderful scribe, but can lose some strange things here and there.

steps.prompt: Start the At First Light quest?

steps.player: Great! Point me in her direction and I'll get cracking!

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: She's behind the bar in the Burrow. Just look for the stressed woman trying to wrangle a bunch of barely- bathed hunters.

steps.player: I'm not sure I have the time for that right now.

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Tetamo... Well, hopefully it's not too important.

steps.player: I'd better be off.

options.text: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.player: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Absolutely. Have you spoken to Verity yet?

steps.player: No, not quite yet.

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: If you're having a hard time finding her, she's behind the bar in the Burrow. Head down the stairs in the big tree. You can't miss it, and if you can, maybe you're not cut out for the Hunter Guild.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.text: If the player has never talked to Guild Scribe Verity:

steps.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
steps.text: Oh, hello there newcomer. I'm Guild Scribe Verity. Do you need me to explain the work we do here?

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
steps.text: So it's nice and simple. Just chat to any of the hunters in here to help them out. They're all following reports that I've split up amongst them.

steps.player: Reports?

steps.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
steps.text: Indeed. There are all sorts of interesting creatures to hunt out there. Sometimes we get reports of a particularly unique example. When that happens, one of the hunters will set out to find it.

steps.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
steps.text: If you do decide to take a job from any of the hunters, they'll tell you what type of creature they're looking into. Hunt that creature until you encounter the unique specimen.

steps.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
steps.text: Once you've caught it, bring some proof back to the hunter that sent you out in the first place. I'm sure they'll reward you for your time.

steps.player: I see. Thanks for the information.

steps.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
steps.text: Now, what else can I do for you.

steps.player: Well actually, I heard there might be something I could help you with?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.text: If the player has previously talked to Guild Scribe Verity:

steps.player: Hi Verity. I heard there might be something I could help you with?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.text: You'll have to be slightly more specific. There's always something that needs doing down here!

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.player: Something a little birdy may have told Apatura?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.text: Tetamo... Pitri needs to stop twittering with the birds. Yes, Gilman and I are concerned about Fox. He left quietly in the night, but we have no record of what he was doing.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.player: Do you normally keep track of the hunters here?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.text: We try to, but it's like herding cats! We at least like to keep an eye on what they're hunting and point them in the right direction. It prevents us from losing track of too many creatures... or people.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.player: Could anyone else have put Fox onto a hunt?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.text: If anyone did, it would've been Wolf. She's always getting Fox into some kind of trouble.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.player: I'll follow up with her then.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.text: Have you spoken to Wolf yet?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-scribe-ve.player: Not yet. I'll have a chat to her now.

options.text: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.player: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Absolutely. So was our little birdy right about Verity needing a hand?

steps.player: They were... It wasn't an actual bird was it?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Of course not. Only Pitri talks to the birds.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: So, here to ask me what trouble I've gotten Fox into, are you?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.player: That's not quite how I'd word it... but how did you know?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: I've honed my instincts over the years.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: Well, that and the fact you had that whole conversation within earshot.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.player: Right... So did you send Fox out to do something?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: Sort of. He's on some very unofficial business for me.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: If I told you... I'd have to kill you!

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: Your face! Don't worry, I'm just pulling your leg.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: I asked him to look into making some repairs to Kiko's bed. It's been getting tatty lately. I'm guessing he didn't end up having the materials needed. That'll be why he headed out.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.player: Well then I guess the first step is to work out what he went to get. Could I take a look at Kiko's bed?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: You're welcome to try, but you'll need to convince Kiko to let you. He's just by the table there.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: He's very easy to distract. We have a little fake mouse we use sometimes.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.player: Could I borrow it when I have a free hand to take it?

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
steps.text: Sure thing.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.player: Could I borrow it to have a go at distracting him?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: Wolf hands you a small toy mouse.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: Have you checked Kiko's bed yet? It's just to the side of this table.
If the player has inventory space and has not yet gotten the mouse:

steps.player: Not yet. Could I grab that mouse to distract him with?

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
steps.text: Absolutely.
Wolf hands you a small toy mouse.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: If the player has the toy mouse in their inventory:

steps.player: Not yet. I'll get to it now.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-guild-hunter-wo.text: If the player lost the toy mouse:

steps.player: Not yet. Do you happen to have that mouse to distract him with?

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
steps.text: I already gave it to you. If you've lost it, you'll need to get another for yourself. I'd do so quickly if I were you. Kiko won't be happy if he finds out it's gone.

a-missing-fox-petting-kiko.text: If the player doesn't have a catspeak amulet or Dragon Slayer II completed:

steps.text: You pet the cat, who leans into your hand in return.

a-missing-fox-petting-kiko.speaker: Guild Hunter Kiko
a-missing-fox-petting-kiko.text: Can you scratch my belly next? It's perfectly safe.

a-missing-fox-using-an-unwound-toy-mouse.speaker: Guild Hunter Kiko
a-missing-fox-using-an-unwound-toy-mouse.text: Are you not going to wind it up first? Come on now, put some effort in.

a-missing-fox-checking-the-cat-bed.speaker: Guild Hunter Kiko
a-missing-fox-checking-the-cat-bed.text: Do you mind? I'm trying to sleep here.
If the player has a toy mouse (wound):

steps.player: Here you go, little guy.

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Kiko
steps.text: A mouse? Fantastic!

You check the cat's bed. It sure could use a little bit of love... and a lot of repairs. It's made of a luxurious fluffy fur that you don't recognise. It looks like someone has intentionally cut off a small bit of it.

a-missing-fox-using-a-wound-toy-mouse-on.text: Kiko happily starts playing with the toy mouse.
You see that the cat's bed is unsurprisingly still in need of repairs.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.player: I managed to have a look at that bed. I've never seen such luxury material for a cat bed before.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.text: Only the best for our Kiko.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.player: I'm guessing it's the actual fur itself that Fox will be looking to replace. It looks like he cut a small bit off. I don't suppose you know where he'd have gone to get that.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.text: We have a contact who lives in Outer Fortis. She stocks the best of the best when it comes to fabrics. That'll be where he went, but knowing Fox, he won't have gone directly there.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.text: He'll have stopped off for a bit of hunting first. There are some pyre foxes about halfway between here and the Locus Oasis that he was eyeing up. I bet that's where you'll find him.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.player: In that case, I'd better get out there then.
I haven't yet. You said he might be hunting pyre foxes, right?

a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
a-missing-fox-talking-to-wolf-after-insp.text: That's right. They're about halfway between here and the Locus Oasis.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-verity-after-sp.player: It seems like Fox is trying to find something to repair Kiko's bed with.

a-missing-fox-talking-to-verity-after-sp.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
a-missing-fox-talking-to-verity-after-sp.text: Why does that not surprise me? There's two things that man loves: that cat, and not filing in his reports correctly.

options.text: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.player: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Absolutely.

steps.player: I checked in with Verity and apparently Fox has gone missing.

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Ha, that certainly sounds like Fox! What errand has Wolf got him running this time?

steps.player: How did you know Wolf was involved?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Let's just say you don't run things around here without good instincts. Let me guess - it's also got something to do with Kiko.

steps.player: That's spot on! How did you know?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: It's an open secret how much Fox and Wolf care about that cat. We all do of course, but those two don't half spoil him rotten.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.player: Are you Fox? Everyone's worried about you.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.text: Something attacked me in the dark... I can't move much...

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.player: Can I help you? Maybe patch you up?

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.text: That would be much appreciated! There should be a couple of plants around to make a poultice... Hold it together with an embertailed jerboa tail, and...

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.text: There should be a couple of plants around to make a... make a...

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.player: Stay with me, Fox! Where are these plants?

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.text: It's a bit fuzzy... I've lost a lot of blood! One should be around here... the other may be near the oasis... with the capybabas... haha, capybaras...

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.player: And what am I making with them?

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.text: A poultice! And hold it together with the tail from an embertailed jerboa.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.text: Don't forget... your traps for the jerboa... they're boxy...

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.text: How's that poul... pool... poultice... Did you find the plants?

options.text: I think I've got them both.

steps.player: I think I've got them both.

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: It doesn't look like you do... Who's the one with the head wound again?

steps.player: Where can I find them?

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: It's a bit fuzzy... I've lost a lot of blood! One should be around here... the other may be near the oasis... with the capybabas... haha, capybaras...

options.text: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.player: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Absolutely.

steps.player: Fox has been injured out in the savannah!

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Well, that is impressive. How has he managed that?

steps.player: He said he was attacked by an unknown assailant.

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Well as you're not offering your condolences, I can only assume he's survived the encounter?

steps.player: He should be fine once I help him make a poultice for the wound.

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Excellent. A final question - was his hand injured?

steps.player: No?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Wonderful! Then I look foward to reading his report.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.player: I've found Fox. He's been injured by something out in the savannah.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.text: Oh no... I should've offered to go with him. It's never sensible to be out after dark alone...

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.player: I'm going to do what I can to make sure he's okay.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.text: Well thanks for checking in at least. He's still breathing and that's all Fox needs to come out on top.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-scribe-ver.player: He's been injured out in the savannah, but I'll do my best to make sure he makes it back.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-scribe-ver.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-scribe-ver.text: Tetamo! Only he could get injured on an errand for a cat!

steps.text: You pull a smooth leaf off the bush.

fox-tracking-picking-the-leafy-bush.text: If the player already has a smooth leaf:

steps.player: I don't think I need any more leaves from this bush.

steps.text: You pull a sticky leaf off the bush.

fox-tracking-picking-the-rough-looking-b.text: If the player already has a sticky leaf:

steps.player: I don't think I need any more leaves from this bush.

fox-tracking-using-two-poultice-ingredie.text: You need leaves from two different plants along with an embertailed jerboa tail to make the poultice Fox asked for.
You craft a makeshift poultice. It looks like it should just about do the job.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.player: I have that poultice here for you.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.text: You give the poultice to Fox.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.text: Kuani! That's making a difference already.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.player: Happy to help. Now, how did you get on finding what you needed to fix Kiko's bed?

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.text: I thought a little detour wouldn't hurt. I'd caught a glimpse of the most stunning pelt ever seen!

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.text: As I was tracking it, I was attacked and knocked out. When I came to, it was gone.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.text: Without a trace, as well as most of my hunting equipment.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.player: Do you think someone attacked you for it, or was it just an opportunist looting you?

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.text: You've already done me a huge favour, but I don't suppose I could ask for one more small one?

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.player: I suppose I could. Especially if it goes towards repairing that cat's bed and getting you back to the guild.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: Well it's your lucky day! Make some room and I'll give you the sample needed to fix the bed.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.text: Well it's your lucky day! Take this sample to a woman called Atza in Outer Fortis. She'll have exactly what we need.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.player: Where in the outskirts can I find her? And... what exactly do we need, again?

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-with-the-mak.text: She lives by the south western gate of the city. She'll be able to give us the matching fur to repair the cat's bed with.
Fox gives you a fur sample.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-after-giving.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-after-giving.text: I thought a little detour wouldn't hurt. I'd caught a glimpse of the most stunning pelt ever seen!

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-before-getti.text: Fox gives you a fur sample.
If the player still has the fur sample or has a full inventory and not yet received the sample:

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: Any success with Atza yet?

steps.player: Not quite.

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: If you're struggling to find her, she's in Outer Fortis, near the south western gate.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-before-getti.text: If the player lost the fur sample and has a full inventory:

steps.player: I appear to have lost the sample you gave me...

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: Luckily, I always come prepared. Here's a spare.

steps.player: Ah. It seems I don't have room for it.

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: Well I'm not going anywhere. Let me know when you do have room.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-before-getti.text: If the player lost the fur sample:

steps.player: I don't suppose you've got another sample of Kiko's bed for me to take to Atza?

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: Fortunately for you, I'm always prepared... And our thief clearly didn't care for fine fur samples.

steps.player: That's convenient! Usually I'm the one that's always ready for these situations.

steps.text: Fox gives you a fur sample.

options.text: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.player: Are you free to talk about my quest?

steps.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
steps.text: Absolutely. How's it going, iknami?

steps.player: We're getting there. I should have everything sorted very soon.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.player: He's doing well. He's got me doing a few things for him whilst he recuperates.

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.text: Ha! Now that's the Fox I know. I'll have to give him some odd jobs once he's back to make up for ones you're covering!

fox-tracking-talking-to-guild-scribe-ver.player: I'm still working on it, but I'm getting there.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.player: Hi there. You must be Atza. I heard you're the person to talk to about getting some material to match a sample?

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.text: I might be. Depends who's asking... and what you're looking for, of course.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.player: Your friend Fox was going to bring this sample to you, but he's been a little... waylaid.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.text: Well, this wouldn't be the first time! Let's take a look.
If the player lost the sample:

steps.player: I don't seem to have it with me.

steps.speaker: Atza
steps.text: You'll have to go back to Fox and grab it then.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.text: You give the fur sample to Atza.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.text: Good, good. Luckily for you, I recognise this fur. I do have a bit left, but I'll have to dig it out.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.player: Shall I just wait here then?

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.text: Oh... Fox usually helps me with my chores when he visits.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.player: That's funny. He didn't mention that to me.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.text: That's alright, I'm sure a capable adventurer like you will manage fine. Fox was going to assemble some equipment for me. You can manage that, can't you?

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.player: I suppose so. Where do I start?

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-talking-to-atza.text: It's all in that pile on the floor there. You can work it out, I'm sure.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza-after-givin.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-talking-to-atza-after-givin.text: Now, luckily for you, I recognise this fur. I do have a bit left, but I'll have to dig it out.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza-after-givin.player: Shall I just wait here then?

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-after-giving.player: Hello again. I've given Atza the fur sample.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-after-giving.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-after-giving.text: Did she give you the matching material?

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox-after-giving.player: Not yet. I should check back in with her.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza-after-she-a.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-talking-to-atza-after-she-a.text: Don't forget, I need a hand setting up that equipment on the floor!

fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.text: You need a hammer to set up this equipment.

fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.text: So anyway, how did you come to be doing this for Fox?

fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.player: Well, he actually got attacked on his way over here.

fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.text: Shouldn't you be helping him heal up?

fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.player: Oh he'll be alright. He was on the mend when I left him.
Now that's done, did you manage to find the material?

fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.text: Atza gives you some trimmed fur.

fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.speaker: Atza
fox-tracking-setting-up-the-pile-of-equi.text: Thanks for your help today. I hope that fur works for your project.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza-after-setti.player: Now that's done, did you manage to find the material?

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza-after-setti.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Atza
steps.text: Yes, but you don't have enough room for it! Come back when you have space.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza-after-setti.text: Atza gives you some trimmed fur.
If the player lost the trimmed fur:

steps.player: Could I get a replacement for that fur? I managed to lose it.

steps.speaker: Atza
steps.text: You can, for now. I don't have an unlimited supply though, so be careful.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Atza
steps.text: Ah, you don't have space for that.
Atza gives you some trimmed fur.

fox-tracking-talking-to-atza-after-setti.text: If the player still has the trimmed fur:

steps.speaker: Atza
steps.text: You should take that material back to Fox.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.player: Hello again. I got the fur from Atza. She's certainly... something.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.text: She didn't make you do odd jobs for her, did she?

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.text: She does it every time I visit!
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: Now, I'll need you to take this report back to Verity, but it looks like you don't have space for it at the moment.

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.text: Anyway, now that's that, would you mind letting Wolf and Verity know I'm okay? Oh, and can you take my report back to the guild?

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.text: Please apologise to Verity for the condition it's in. Oh, and of course, don't forget to use that fur along with another embertailed jerboa tail to fix Kiko's bed!

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.player: Want me to save the world while I'm at it?

fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
fox-tracking-talking-to-fox.text: No need! You've already saved my world by making Kiko happy.

fox-tracking-reading-fox-s-report.text: It's Fox's report. It details the creature he was tracking, his attack, and my help.

fox-tracking-reading-fox-s-report-talkin.text: If the player lost Fox's report:

steps.player: I've lost your report.

steps.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: How is it you've lost the report and yet you somehow don't have space for another one?

steps.player: Well, that's just the adventuring way! If something isn't tied down, I'll grab it, and probably lose it at some point too!

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: You're lucky I don't have anywhere else to be. I'll write you another one. Just a moment...
Fox writes up another report and hands it to you.

fox-tracking-reading-fox-s-report-talkin.text: If the player still has Fox's report:

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
steps.text: Hello there. Have you taken that report back to Verity yet?

steps.player: Not yet. I still need to get around to it.

finishing-up-talking-to-verity.text: You give Fox's report to Guild Scribe Verity.

finishing-up-talking-to-verity.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
finishing-up-talking-to-verity.text: Is that Fox's report? Thanks for bringing that back to us. How was he?

finishing-up-talking-to-verity.player: He's injured, but he's on the mend. I expect he'll be back in here soon enough.

finishing-up-talking-to-verity.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
finishing-up-talking-to-verity.text: Good to hear. Once you're done with the cat's bed, you might want to check in with Guildmaster Apatura.

finishing-up-talking-to-verity-before-re.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
finishing-up-talking-to-verity-before-re.text: Thanks for all your help. Once you're done with the cat's bed, you might want to check in with Guildmaster Apatura.

finishing-up-talking-to-verity-before-re.player: I'll go and speak to her now.

finishing-up-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.player: Just about sorted. He'll be back here very soon.

finishing-up-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.speaker: Guild Hunter Fox
finishing-up-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.text: Hello there. Have you taken that report back to Verity yet?

finishing-up-talking-to-guild-hunter-fox.player: I have. She was glad to hear that you'll be back soon.

finishing-up-repairing-kiko-s-bed.text: If the player doesn't have the required items:

steps.text: You can see the cat bed needs repairs, but you'll need the right materials along with a needle and an embertailed jerboa tail to fix it.

finishing-up-repairing-kiko-s-bed.text: If the player has the required items:

steps.text: You carefully fix up Kiko's bed.

steps.speaker: Guild Hunter Kiko
steps.text: Well as much as I resent the trickery used, this bed is much comfier now.

finishing-up-talking-to-guild-scribe-ver.speaker: Guild Scribe Verity
finishing-up-talking-to-guild-scribe-ver.text: Thanks for all your help. Have you checked in with the Guildmaster?

finishing-up-talking-to-guild-scribe-ver.player: I'll go and speak to her now.

finishing-up-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.player: Looks like the Fox situation is all sorted.

finishing-up-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.speaker: Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)
finishing-up-talking-to-guild-hunter-wol.text: Thank you, hunter. I'm not sure I could have forgiven myself if something terrible had happened to him.

finishing-up-talking-to-apatura.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
finishing-up-talking-to-apatura.text: Kuani! So what was so important for our darling Kiko that poor Fox risked life and limb?

finishing-up-talking-to-apatura.player: So, basically Wolf sent Fox to get fur to fix Kiko's bed, but he actually needed to talk to Atza, and Atza needed me to...

finishing-up-talking-to-apatura.speaker: Guildmaster Apatura
finishing-up-talking-to-apatura.text: Actually... I think I'll just read the report.
